WITH item_town AS (
  SELECT
    oi.order_item_id,
    c.town_city,
    AVG(ili.product_price) AS avg_price,
    AVG(ili.derived_product_cost / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_cost_ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili
  JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id
  JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  GROUP BY oi.order_item_id, c.town_city
), town_averages AS (
  SELECT
    town_city,
    AVG(avg_price) AS average_price,
    AVG(avg_cost_ratio) AS average_cost_ratio
  FROM item_town
  GROUP BY town_city
), cross_town_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(average_cost_ratio) AS avg_cost_ratio
  FROM town_averages
)
SELECT
  ta.town_city AS town,
  ta.average_price,
  ta.average_cost_ratio,
  ta.average_cost_ratio - cta.avg_cost_ratio AS ratio_above_cross_town_average
FROM town_averages AS ta
CROSS JOIN cross_town_average AS cta
WHERE ta.average_cost_ratio > cta.avg_cost_ratio;
